path.data-subject-role: Selected orthographic front-oblique cylindrical Hubble barrel silhouette. Upper front-cap limb and lower rear limb retained; lower front-cap seam deliberately omitted, not falsely labelled invisible. No actual NASA dimensional measurement.
Complete projected circular optical entrance ellipse in front cap. Optical line-of-sight entry reference, not a certified through-hole or proof of absent glass/mirrors/internal hardware.
ONE selected post2002 rigid solar-array wing rectangular outline. Two wings total, no tiny cells/grid,current power reading or third array.

Projected simplified array-support centreline joining barrel-side and array-edge at exact Tcontacts; one support per selected wing, no measured structural width, flexible cable or separate solar array.
